title: A flirtation that goes wrong
watchFor: Vex likes the player and deflects with jokes. The flirtation should feel real and adult, then sour when the player pushes on her old running partner (her secret): she should shut down the way her voice card says (quieter, not louder), not explain her feelings. The summary should lower trust or approval, not end everything.

moods.vex: loose, a drink in, enjoying herself

turns: You look good tonight, Vex. The Courier jacket suits you.
Let me buy you something better than a lantern-pour.
So who sold out your old partner? Was it Oria's people?
